summary: Implemented v1.1 Phase 12 task 12.4 (ADR-017 clause 6 and ADR-019 clause 6): the single coordinated output-affecting version advance, the committed-golden regeneration with no writer/auto-approval path, new anchor/size goldens, and the Goal B/E documentation reconciliation. `RendererConfiguration.CurrentSchemaVersion` advanced from 1 to 2 and `RenderVersion.CurrentRendererVersion` advanced from 2 to 3; these are the only advanced version values (`RenderVersion.CurrentBadgeSchemaVersion` stays 2, owned by `BadgeMetadata.CurrentSchemaVersion`). The nine existing default-configuration goldens (BottomLeft/Medium/empty allowlist) keep byte-identical PNGs (git shows no modification to any existing PNG; their OutputHash values in the manifest are unchanged) because the default reproduces the V1 output, while their OutputFingerprint values change with the renderer version. Four new anchor/size goldens with PNGs and manifest entries were added: `top-left` (TopLeft/Medium), `top-right-large` (TopRight/Large with the status pill moved top-left), `bottom-right-small` (BottomRight/Small), and `center` (Center/Medium). Regeneration was performed by a throwaway test-class generator (writes only when ARRTAGS_GOLDEN_REGEN_DIR is set) that was deleted and the project rebuilt before completion, so the committed test code remains read-only over the goldens (no File.Write* to the Goldens directory and no auto-update/auto-approve flag); RenderGoldenTests still fails closed on any golden or render change. A non-native test pins the single coordinated advance, and the existing native byte-determinism fact now also renders a non-default placement case repeatedly (no new default skip). The existing fingerprint tests already cover position/size/allowlist sensitivity. Documentation updated: docs/architecture.md section 9 and its status line, docs/data-model.md 3.6/3.12, README.md, docs/decisions.md (ADR-019 plus the ADR-009/ADR-010 supersession notes), PLANS.md (12.4 checkbox/status, Phase 12 milestone row, Project Status), docs/changelog.md (Task 12.4 entry and Phase 12 status), and the current-state surfaces docs/project-status.md, docs/implementation-readiness.md, and docs/limitations.md V6 with the exact post-task suite counts. Gate 12 is not claimed met and the v1.1.0-phase12 tag was not created.

known_limitations: The throwaway golden generator wrote the four new PNGs and the manifest before being deleted; it is not part of the final diff, but it means the committed goldens were produced by a one-off process rather than a reproducible in-repo command. The no-writer/auto-approval property of the shipped tests is preserved and independently verifiable (grep for File.Write in the golden test code).

The new anchor/size goldens are produced and compared on the pinned canonical SkiaSharp runtime only. The non-canonical cross-runtime set (Goldens/non-canonical) is absent, so the tolerant cross-runtime comparison remains an honest skip (RendererCrossRuntimeTests 1) as it was before this task; this is pre-existing and recorded in docs/limitations.md V2.

The v1.1 allowlist and placement behavior is verified at the integration-test and forced-native golden level; the live pinned-host end-to-end confirmation is not part of this task and is owned by task 14.3.

The ADR-019 status-line implementation note and the ADR-009/ADR-010 supersession-note wording are documentation wording decisions made under this task; they are accurate to the shipped state and traceable but were not separately reviewed before this report.
